# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for loyal, completed orders
loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
num_qa = len(qa_orders)

# Remove QA orders
loyal_completed_clean = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue
total_revenue = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_clean'].sum()
num_orders = len(loyal_completed_clean)
mean_revenue = total_revenue / num_orders

# Print all required values — must be the only way to produce evidence
print("Number of loyal, completed orders:", len(loyal_completed))
print("Number of QA orders in loyal, completed set:", num_qa)
print("Mean revenue (after removing QA orders):"," , mean_revenue)"}}
